entries.title: Your panels keep working while the app is busy
entries.body: A panel or a card that runs its own script no longer stops with "stopped responding" just because the app itself was busy for a while. When a panel does stop and its fresh page then works, a later stop opens a fresh page again on its own instead of waiting for you to press Retry.
entries.noPicture: The change is a stopped line that no longer appears over time, which a still picture cannot show apart from an ordinary panel.
